#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

LOG="/root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d066_qwen_beam_sweep.log"
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1

echo "[$(date)] d066 Qwen DocRED beam sweep wrapper started"

# Wait for d065 LLaMA unc (GPU0) to finish
TARGET_PID=697390
echo "[$(date)] Waiting for PID $TARGET_PID (d065 LLaMA unc) to finish..."
while kill -0 $TARGET_PID 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 30
done
echo "[$(date)] PID $TARGET_PID finished. GPU0 is free."

# Setup
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/schema_semantic_constrained_ie

QWEN_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen_lora_docred_merged"
DATA_PATH="data/docred/dev.json"
CONSTRAINTS_PATH="data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json"
OUTDIR="/root/autodl-tmp/schema_outputs/d066_beam_sweep"
VIOL_DIR="${OUTDIR}/violations"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR" "$VIOL_DIR"
MAX_DOCS=200
MAX_NEW_TOKENS=4096

run_one() {
    local beam=$1 mode=$2
    local out_name="qwen_docred_200_beam${beam}_${mode}"
    local out_file="${OUTDIR}/${out_name}.jsonl"

    if [ -f "$out_file" ]; then
        local n_lines=$(wc -l < "$out_file")
        if [ "$n_lines" -ge $MAX_DOCS ]; then
            echo "[$(date)] SKIP ${out_name} (already complete: ${n_lines} lines)"
            return 0
        fi
    fi

    echo "[$(date)] START ${out_name} on GPU0"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python run_constrained_extraction.py \
        --mode "$mode" \
        --dataset docred \
        --model_path "$QWEN_MODEL" \
        --data_path "$DATA_PATH" \
        --constraints_path "$CONSTRAINTS_PATH" \
        --output_path "$out_file" \
        --device cuda:0 \
        --max_new_tokens $MAX_NEW_TOKENS \
        --max_docs $MAX_DOCS \
        --seed 42 \
        --decoding_strategy beam \
        --num_beams "$beam" \
        --skip_on_error
    echo "[$(date)] DONE ${out_name} ($(wc -l < "$out_file") lines)"
}

run_one 2 unconstrained
run_one 2 full_s1
run_one 8 unconstrained
run_one 8 full_s1

echo "[$(date)] Running violation checks..."

    for mode in unconstrained full_s1; do
        out_name="qwen_docred_200_beam${beam}_${mode}"
        in_file="${OUTDIR}/${out_name}.jsonl"
        viol_file="${VIOL_DIR}/${out_name}_violations.json"
        if [ -f "$in_file" ]; then
            python violation_checker_docred.py \

                --constraints_path "$CONSTRAINTS_PATH" \
                --output_path "$viol_file" 2>/dev/null && \
                echo "[$(date)] Violation check done: ${out_name}" || \
                echo "[$(date)] Violation check FAILED: ${out_name}"
        fi
    done
done

# Evaluation
echo "[$(date)] Running eval_d064.py for each config..."
for beam in 2 8; do

        out_name="qwen_docred_200_beam${beam}_${mode}"

            python scripts/eval_d064.py --input_path "$in_file" --label "${out_name}"
